parameters.name: DatabaseId
parameters.description: The ID of the physical database. You can obtain this ID by calling [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) or [SearchDatabase](~~141876~~).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: RealLoginUserUid
parameters.description: The ID of the user that calls the API.

parameters.name: ReturnGuid
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return the globally unique identifier (GUID) of the table. Valid values:

- **true**: Returns the GUID of the table.

- **false**: Does not return the GUID of the table.

parameters.name: SearchName
parameters.description: The keyword for a fuzzy search on table names.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description: The tenant ID. You can obtain this ID by calling [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~).
